title: A small game, eight systems built against one spec
skill: a long, multi-system build: many features across two squads that must fit together, where later work can break earlier work
request: Implement the game in docs/spec.md: waves, chase, the weapon and bullets, deaths and gems, contact damage, levelling and level-up choices, the run summary, and save/load (which needs the random generator in src/core/rng.js to report and resume its state without changing its numbers). Follow the spec exactly. src/sim/world.js already calls every system in the right order; keep that order and the world's shape, and implement each system in its own module.

squads.name: Gameplay
squads.mission: Simulation rules (player, weapons, bullets, enemies, waves, combat, pickups, progression) and the data tables that tune them.

plan.summary: Engine makes the RNG saveable; Gameplay implements each system in its own module against the spec, then save/load on top of the RNG state.
risks: the systems run in a fixed order each tick; implementations must not reorder them or change the world's shape

tasks.title: Saveable RNG
tasks.objective: Add rng.state() and createRng(seed, state) to src/core/rng.js so a generator can be saved and resumed, without changing the numbers it produces.
acceptanceCriteria: createRng(7)'s sequence is unchanged
createRng(seed, a.state()) continues a's sequence
state survives a JSON round trip
tasks.testPlan: sequence regression, resume from state, JSON round trip

tasks.title: Enemy waves
tasks.objective: Implement spawnWaves in src/sim/spawn.js per docs/spec.md step 1.
acceptanceCriteria: a wave every 60 ticks
3 + floor(tick / 300) enemies
40 from the player at angles from world.rng.next() in turn
ids count up from 1 across waves
tasks.testPlan: wave timing, growth, placement against a reference rng, ids

tasks.title: Chase, deaths and contact damage
tasks.objective: Implement moveEnemies, removeDead and contactDamage in src/sim/enemies.js per docs/spec.md steps 2, 5 and 6.
acceptanceCriteria: enemies step toward the player at speed 1, landing on it when closer
dead enemies are removed, counted and drop gems
contact costs 10 hp once per tick then 30 ticks of invulnerability
hp 0 ends the run
tasks.testPlan: movement, death and gems, contact and invulnerability, game over

tasks.title: Auto-weapon and bullets
tasks.objective: Implement fireWeapon and moveBullets in src/sim/weapon.js per docs/spec.md steps 3 and 4, using the world's weapon stats.
acceptanceCriteria: fires at the nearest enemy in range (lowest id on a tie)
cooldown counts down
bullets move, hit the first enemy in id order, expire on ttl
upgraded stats are used
tasks.testPlan: firing, cooldown, targeting, hits, expiry, upgraded stats

tasks.title: Gems, levels and upgrade choices
tasks.objective: Implement collectGems, offerLevelUp and choose in src/sim/progression.js per docs/spec.md steps 7 and 8 and the upgrade table.
acceptanceCriteria: gems in pickup radius add xp
thresholds raise level and queue choices
a pending level-up pauses and offers 3 upgrades from world.rng
each upgrade's effect
invalid choices throw
multiple pending level-ups chain
tasks.testPlan: collection, levelling, offers, every upgrade, errors, chained level-ups

tasks.title: Summary, save and load
tasks.objective: Implement summary, save and load in src/sim/save.js so a loaded world continues exactly as the saved one would.
acceptanceCriteria: summary reports tick, kills, level, xp, hp, over
save returns JSON
load restores the world and its rng position
tasks.testPlan: summary fields, round trip, rng continuity
